item.title: The Summer of 1993: My Father and Me in Beidaihe
item.description: A photograph taken around June 1993 shows me at fifteen beside my forty-two-year-old father in Beidaihe. Thirty-three years later, I realize he was younger then than I am now.

item.title: A Helping Hand
item.description: An elderly woman asking for directions in Chengde made me notice the pavements, barriers and tactile paths I usually hurry past, and remember that all of us will grow old.

item.title: Laofangzi Tavern: A Taste of Chengde Tucked Away on Mashi Street
item.description: Near Huoshenmiao in central Chengde, Laofangzi Tavern has served homestyle food for more than twenty years. Traditional dishes and an easygoing owner have made it a familiar place to gather with friends.

item.title: A Three-Yuan Car Wash—and Why the Math Actually Works
item.description: A supermarket car-wash benefit offers a glimpse into why retailers sometimes provide services that make little sense as standalone businesses.

item.title: ZISAI at 28: Technology Changes, Habits Stay
item.description: During the National Day holiday, I rebuilt ZISAI once again. Work carries responsibility; this website runs on personal curiosity. Technology, design and small details became part of something I wanted to make well.

item.title: Do You Remember the Elephant Slide in Chengde’s Mountain Resort?
item.description: Old photographs, memories and AI help piece together a vanished elephant slide in Chengde’s Mountain Resort, and the childhoods of several generations.

item.title: IT Is Like Air: You May Not Notice It, but You Cannot Do Without It 🌐
item.description: IT is often overlooked in traditional businesses. Like air, it provides the foundations for operations, innovation and growth. This reflection explores its practical value and strategic role.

item.title: ZISAI: Web Memories from 1998 to Today
item.description: ZISAI began in Chengde in 1998. These preserved pages trace its evolution from a local internet website to a personal blog, keeping memories of Chengde, the internet and a personal journey.

item.title: About Shen Nan
item.description: Shen Nan, founder of ZISAI and Director, Vice President and CIO of Chengde Kuangguang Holdings Group. More than three decades in communications, the internet and retail digitalization.
